subject: Symphony Platform — request: trial extension + combined credit concession
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@symphonyplatform.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request — trial extension + credits for cross-team POC

Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood’s latency profile and the dedicated routing options. Procurement and IT have hit a few internal gates and asked us to stretch the POC window to get both the platform and the security review in the same run.

Two asks from our side: 1) Can Symphony get an additional 30 days on the existing trial while procurement completes the contract review? 2) Given the broader trial footprint (we're enabling two product teams across dev and ML), would Redwood consider a one-time credit of $25,000 to cover extra tokens and evaluation costs? That helps us avoid interrupting the POC mid-workflow and keeps momentum.

We can share the POC plan and the security questionnaire if that helps. Need a quick yes/no so we can align internal calendars.

Best,
Alyssa Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
Symphony Platform

Attachment: Symphony_POC_plan.pdf (105KB)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@symphonyplatform.com>
Date: 2028-09-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request — trial extension + credits for cross-team POC

Alyssa — really appreciate the context and glad the demo landed well. Short answers: we can usually approve 30-day extensions without signoff; credits are an exception that require approval because they impact payout and precedent.

I'll escalate to the approvals committee this morning and propose a combined concession: 30 extra days + a pilot credit in the $20–30k band depending on the procurement cadence and SOW commitment. Can you confirm: (a) which two product teams (names), (b) expected monthly token run rate during the extended trial, and (c) whether there is a signed NDA in place? That will help me make the case.

I'll loop back within 48 hours.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Exec, Enterprise 
Redwood Inference
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-11T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Symphony — request: trial extension + credits (deal SYM-2028-092-PRC) — approval request

Marissa / Hannah,

Forwarding a request from Symphony (Alyssa Park). Summary: they want +30 days on the trial and a one-time credit to cover additional evaluation usage. Customer is running a cross-team POC (two product teams: Search UX + Backend ML infra). Estimated incremental burn: ~600k tokens/week over the extension (we'd conservatively budget for a $28k credit).

Why I recommend approving: Symphony is a strategic vertical prospect (data-intensive marketplace platform), procurement delay is timing-based rather than product-related, and approving a modest credit will preserve momentum and likely convert to a mid-six-figure ARR commit within 90 days.

Request: Exec-level authorization for 30 days + $28,000 one-time credit, conditioned on: - execution of the attached SOW draft within 30 days of extension start; - standard audit logging (Redwood Private option not required but they will run security scans); - HubSpot deal update with new close plan (I added notes).

Attachments: Symphony_POC_plan.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

Appreciate quick guidance — they need an answer to coordinate procurement.

Best,
Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: finance-approvals@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-12T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Symphony — request: trial extension + credits (deal SYM-2028-092-PRC) — approval request

Jonas — looked through the POC plan and pressure-tested the revenue-risk assumptions with finance. Approve the 30-day extension immediately. For the credit, approve a one-time $25,000 pilot credit (not the full $28k requested) conditioned on: (1) signed SOW or MOU within 30 days, (2) a mutual action plan (MAP) in HubSpot with defined success criteria, and (3) inclusion of a 3-month conversion checkpoint that triggers a promotional discount discussion (not automatic).

Finance concurs with $25k as a reasonable concession to keep momentum and minimize precedent exposure. Please add hannah for operational gating and confirm when you’ve communicated to the customer.

— Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Ops 
Redwood Inference
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Date: 2028-09-14T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Approval confirmed — 30-day extension + $25,000 pilot credit (Symphony POC)

Alyssa — good news: we approved the request. Details below and next steps:

What we approved
- 30-day trial extension starting 2028-09-15 (no interruption to existing environment).
- One-time pilot credit of $25,000 to be applied to your Redwood account to cover additional POC usage during the extension.

Conditions & next steps
1) Please sign the attached MOU / SOW draft (I’ve attached the version Marissa reviewed) within 30 days. We’ll provision the credit upon signature.
2) Add a short MAP in HubSpot with success criteria and the two product teams named (Search UX, Backend ML infra). I’ll create the record if you prefer.
3) We’ll hold a 3-month check-in for conversion to production; any future discounts or rate negotiations will be discussed at that checkpoint.

I’ve also included a DocuSign link if that’s easiest for procurement: https://www.docusign.com/en/members/abc123-MOU. Let me know if procurement needs certificate of insurance or an additional security call — Hannah can help coordinate.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call tomorrow to align calendars.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
